request.style: English, male voice, solo, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, solemn and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the beginning, all was new
God created heavens, earth and dew
The earth was formless, empty space
Darkness covered the deep, deep place

[Pre-Chorus]
The Spirit of God hovered near
Over the face of waters clear

[Chorus]
And God said, let there be light
And there was light, a sudden sight
God saw the light was good and true
Separated it from night and dew

[Verse]
Before the sun, before the stars
Before the moon or distant mars
The deep was dark, the void was wide
But God stood there on the other side

[Chorus]
And God said, let there be light
And there was light, a sudden sight
God saw the light was good and true
Separated it from night and dew

[Verse]
No eye to see, no ear to hear
No breath to fill the empty air
Just the Spirit, hovering and still
Waiting for the light to fill

[Pre-Chorus]
The formless earth, the empty sea
The darkness lay, wild and free

[Chorus]
And God said, let there be light
And there was light, a sudden sight
God saw the light was good and true
Separated it from night and dew

[Bridge]
Goodness made, division done
Light kept apart, a day begun

[Outro]
In the beginning, light was made
God created all that has been made
